g.text: The disclosed floor is now most of the estimate above it

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: the site's TOTAL tab — its modeled estimate of global tokens per day against the disclosed floor beneath

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: it, over 12 quarterly estimate points and 18 floor steps. The same data is drawn twice: linear as the site draws it, and

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: logarithmic so the first eighteen months are legible.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Tokens Per Day (tokensperday.com) — tokens_per_day_total.csv — chartData objects and evidence ledger as extracted 2026-08-21

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows the Tokens Per Day published methodology and estimates pages

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: The estimate ends at 360.4T/day and the floor at 300.3T/day — the floor is now 83% of the estimate, against 6% in Oct 2024, which

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: TPD-D01 plots directly. On the linear panel everything before mid-2025 sits on the axis; that is a property of the growth, not of the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: data. This is one publisher's index, not an industry return. The floor is what companies said; everything above it is triangulated

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: from revenue, hardware, users and telemetry by parties who do not have the numbers.
